preprocessing: EXIF orientation applied, converted to RGB, resized to 224x224 with LANCZOS (no cropping, aspect ratio not preserved), then Resize((224, 224)), ToTensor and ImageNet normalization. Mirrors training/prepare_dataset.py + training/evaluate_efficientnet.py.

quality.independence_note: Some images are identical or possibly near-identical to images the model was built from. Those images are not independent.
quality.duplicate_detection_limits: Exact duplicates are found by SHA-256 of file bytes, so any re-encoding, resizing, cropping or metadata change hides a copy. Possible near-duplicates are found with a 64-bit difference hash (Hamming distance <= 3); this can miss crops, rotations, mirrored or heavily edited copies and can occasionally match different but similar-looking photos, so matches need manual review.
warnings: 31 class(es) have fewer than 10 images, so their per-class metrics are unreliable.
3 group(s) of exact duplicate images within the real-world set (15 extra copies; 1 with conflicting labels).
